name: Grand Theft Auto: Ice City
tagline: A whole city at night: walk into any building, rob the bank properly, steal a tank
description:
Grand Theft Auto: Ice City is a top-down open-city crime game from the Take the Bus! series.

Every building on the street has a door and something inside: restaurants, pubs, a karaoke bar, a mall, boutiques, a barber who changes your hair, factories you can sabotage, a power station whose breaker kills the lights, a bus depot, hotels, a gym, a cinema, a church, the kommune office and its queues. Each one has its own people and things to do.

Fjord Savings Bank is a full heist: blind the cameras, take the manager's keycard, put the hostages on the floor, drill the vault, crack the deposit boxes, then get out through the waves of police and SWAT. Camp Bussby has soldiers, an armoury and parked jeeps, trucks, an APC and a tank you can steal; SWAT Command sends its vans when you are wanted enough.

Answer the ringing payphones for Artur's missions, five live radio stations, side jobs in taxis, buses, ambulances and fire trucks, a Pay 'n' Spray, and a car sound lab in the settings to tune how every engine sounds.

Controls: WASD or arrows to walk and drive, walk into a door to enter, F to get in and out of cars and to use things, Space for the handbrake, click or Ctrl to shoot, L for headlights, Tab for the big map, P or Esc to pause, O for settings. Best with a graphics card (WebGL).
patchNotes: Every street-facing building can be entered, with 48 themed interiors and their own people and interactions. The bank is now a multi-stage heist (cameras, keycard, hostages, vault, deposit boxes, police and SWAT waves, a score at the end). New: Camp Bussby army base with stealable military vehicles and a tank, and SWAT Command. Rooms turn so their door is on the side you came in from. Two headlights and two brake lights on every car, lit from the bumpers. Night lighting is WebGL only. Calmer engine sounds, and a car sound lab in Settings.
